instruction: Open the Symbol Editor and create a new project symbol library named "proj_sym.kicad_sym" in the project folder. In that library, create and save a symbol named "TEST_SYM" with at least one pin.

verification.condition: Check that /home/user/Desktop/test_files/kicad_pro/test/proj_sym.kicad_sym exists and its contents include the text 'symbol "TEST_SYM"'.
verification.expected_result: The symbol library file proj_sym.kicad_sym is created and contains a symbol named TEST_SYM.
